title: Main Zainab hoon
body:
main karbobala ke maqtal se
bhuke bachon ko layi hoon
ghar baar luta kar sab apna
bhai ko ganwa kar aayi hoon
<<MINI>>
main zainab hoon main zainab hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ko kho chuki hoon
<<MINI>>
main zainab hoon main zainab hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
1. bhai ki amanat la na saki
yeh tegh jigar par layi hoon
zindan mein sakina bibi ki
main khabr bana kar ayi hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch baat karo mujhse bhaiya ..main zainab hoon
2. main shaam mein jakar aye bhai
darbar sitam ka dhayi hoon
darbar sitam ka dhakar main
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ka parcham layi hoon
zalim ko kiya main ne paspa..main zainab hoon . . . .
3. wada huwa pura aye bhai
maqsad ko bacha kar layi hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan mein musibat se chut kar
main chehlum karna ayi hoon
jalta hain jigar ghumse mera..main zainab hoon .
4. shadi main huwi yeh barbadi
<<DIVIDER>>
main chot jigar par khayi hoon
bewa huwi dulhan hai ghazab
saat usko main apne layi hoon
pamal huwa qasim dulha..main zainab hoon . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
5. cheni gayi chadar sar se mere
main pusht pe durre khayi hoon
hain neel rasan ke bazo par
yeh ajre risalat payi hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
halat yeh meri dekho to zara ..main zainab hoon . .
6.rudad -e- safar sunlo amma
har gaam pe main dekh payi hoon
saugat -e- safar main bhai ka
<<DIVIDER>>
main khoon bhara kurta layi hoon
ab mushkil hain jeena mera.. main zainab hoon . . . .
7. maare gaye athara bhai
takhdeer main kaisi payi hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ko ganwa kar ayi hoon
kunbe ko luta kar ayi hoon
kehti thi hasan rokar dukhiya
main zainab hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
main zainab hoon . . . .
